title: MEIKO — Warm Gaze〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku! Come on in.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi. Am I your only customer?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For now, but I think Kohane and her friends are coming soon.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've been practicing quite a bit for their next event, recently. They really want to give it everything they have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I got a little worried too when Kohane looked so glum the other day...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it seems like Kohane and An got things sorted out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, you already know about this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Kind of...
I knew she came here for advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I guessed from her expression that something was on her mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, then you could have talked to her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, you two were already in the middle of a discussion and I didn't want to interrupt.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Besides, Kohane managed to find her own way to deal with her problems before.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Plus, An's a determined and resourceful girl.
I was sure she'd be fine without me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And they had you to lean on if they really needed anything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It turned out just as you expected then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I listened to their troubles, but I didn't tell them exactly what to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They solved their problem by facing it together without my help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I was surprised that Kohane and An would sort of fall out like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They do get along very well, but don't forget that they haven't known each other for very long.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're still in the process of finding out what each other's like and learning to understand one another.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think that this little stumble was a necessary step on their way to becoming closer friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right. They struck me as such an amazing team, so I assumed that they'd always be in tune...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they may still run into some rough patches...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and they may end up hurting each other's feelings...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Even when you're friends with someone, you may sometimes offend them without meaning to or be disappointed by something they did...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you don't seem particularly worried?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not. Those are just some possibilities. I enjoy sitting back and watching how the future unfolds.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Besides, they've discovered the joy of singing together as Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whatever happens, I don't think they'll be willing to give that up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Another reason they won't let minor hiccups like that get in their way is that they have this goal of surpassing the legendary RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. They've already discovered their true feelings too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Their SEKAI song will keep reminding them of their shared vision.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm excited to see just how much they manage to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I believe that they will fulfill their dream.
I want to see them do it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I do too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, and they've just arrived in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll go out and say hi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. Have fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll brew up some special tea and coffee for when they get here.
